Kintsugi Unisex Softstyle® Midweight Hoodie
Product Description:
Embrace the beauty of imperfection with our 'Kintsugi' hoodie. Inspired by the ancient Japanese art of repairing broken pottery with gold, this hoodie symbolizes the philosophy that there is beauty in repair and strength in embracing one’s flaws. It’s perfect for anyone who appreciates the deeper messages of resilience, renewal, and rebirth that Kintsugi represents.

This piece connects the wearer to a profound cultural tradition, celebrating the concept that breaking is not the end but a new beginning. Whether you're a lover of Japanese art, a ceramist who practices Kintsugi, or someone who values the metaphoric significance of this art form in everyday life, this hoodie speaks to your appreciation of transformative beauty.

Cosy is the new cool. This unisex hoodie is wonderfully soft on the inside, offering comfort and warmth as you carry the spirit of Kintsugi with you. It’s ideal for thoughtful days in the studio or reflective moments in your daily routine, reminding you to find the golden seams in life’s unexpected turns.

Wear this hoodie as a declaration of your belief in recovery and transformation, or gift it to someone who sees the art in healing and the beauty in life’s imperfections. 'Kintsugi' is not just a style—it's a statement about the power of healing and the art of living.

Classic fit unisex hoodie without seams featuring drop shoulder
With two-part hood featuring colour-coordinated jersey lining and kangaroo pouch
1x1 rib knit with elastane on cuffs and hem

Embrace your passion without interruption with our 'Just Let Me Make Ceramics' hoodie. This hoodie is a straightforward plea for space and time to indulge in your craft, perfect for the dedicated ceramicist who prefers the company of clay over anything else. It's designed for those who find their truest expression and greatest satisfaction at the potter's wheel or sculpting table.

This piece speaks directly to the heart of every ceramic artist who just wants to be left in their creative bubble, making it an ideal wear for studio days, art classes, or casual outings where you might still be daydreaming about glazes and kiln schedules.

Cosy is the new cool. This unisex hoodie is wonderfully soft on the inside, providing all the comfort you need for those long, uninterrupted sessions of crafting or those moments when you're recuperating from a productive day. It’s your go-to garment for both working in and stepping out of the studio.

Wear this hoodie as a friendly warning to others about your priorities, or gift it to a fellow ceramist who appreciates the sentiment as much as you do. 'Just Let Me Make Ceramics' isn't just a request; it's a statement of your dedication to the art.

Product Details
Classic fit unisex hoodie without seams featuring drop shoulder
With two-part hood featuring colour-coordinated jersey lining and kangaroo pouch
1x1 rib knit with elastane on cuffs and hem
With black tear-off label
Soft fabric density: 285 g/m²
Material: 80% cotton, 20% polyester

Embody the life of a true potter with our 'Eat Sleep Pottery' hoodie. This catchy phrase isn't just a slogan—it's a lifestyle for those dedicated to the art of ceramics. Designed for the avid potter, this hoodie is perfect for anyone whose day revolves around the wheel and kiln.

Wear this hoodie to show off your pottery passion, or give it as a gift to someone who lives and breathes ceramics. 'Eat Sleep Pottery' is more than just a catchy saying—it's an affirmation of your commitment to the craft.

Find your center with our 'Pottery Zen' hoodie, designed for potters who embrace the meditative and therapeutic aspects of their craft. Wear the 'Pottery Zen' hoodie as a reminder of the peace you find in your art, or gift it to someone who appreciates the serene and contemplative nature of ceramic work. It’s more than just a piece of clothing; it’s a part of your mindful pottery journey.
